title: AI Pair Programming for Git-Backed Codebase Refactoring
summary_answer: Aider acts as an AI pair programmer in the terminal, automatically identifying and adding relevant files to context using Tree-sitter repository maps to execute refactoring or bug fixes with commit-friendly workflows.
prerequisites: Python environment, Git repository, LLM API key (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
reproducible_steps: Install aider via pip | Navigate to local Git repo | Run `aider <file>` with a refactoring prompt | Review and approve generated Git commits.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Refactor this module to use dependency injection, update tests, and commit with a descriptive message."
limitations: Requires local Git setup; performance depends on model's context window and Tree-sitter parsing accuracy.
source_title: Aider — AI Pair Programming in Your Terminal

title: Autonomous GitHub Issue Resolution via Agent Canvas
summary_answer: OpenHands triggers from GitHub issues, explores the repository for context, writes code to resolve the issue, and opens a pull request for human review.
prerequisites: Docker, GitHub token, OpenHands installation.
reproducible_steps: Install OpenHands locally | Connect GitHub repository via Agent Canvas | Assign a GitHub issue to the agent | Review the auto-generated PR.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Resolve GitHub issue #<number> by implementing the requested feature and ensuring all tests pass."
limitations: Complex multi-repo dependencies may require manual scaffolding; sandbox execution limits external network access unless explicitly configured.
source_title: OpenHands — Open Source AI Coding Agent Platform

title: Automated Software Engineering for Repository Edits and Tests
summary_answer: SWE-agent autonomously uses tools to fix GitHub issues or perform custom tasks by interacting with a sandboxed Agent-Computer Interface (ACI) to run tests and apply patches.
prerequisites: Python, Docker, SWE-bench compatible repository, API key.
reproducible_steps: Clone SWE-agent repo | Configure environment with LLM API key | Run `python run.py --model <model> --instance <github_issue>` | Evaluate patch against repository test suite.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Fix the failing test in <file> by analyzing the traceback and applying a minimal patch."
limitations: Struggles with highly dynamic GUI tasks; optimized primarily for text-based code repositories and SWE-bench evaluation.

title: Spec-Driven Development and Automated Branch Management
summary_answer: Claude Code automates ticket details retrieval from Jira, creates branches, plans changes, and updates testing notes through a spec-driven development workflow.
prerequisites: Claude API access, terminal environment, Jira/GitHub integration.
reproducible_steps: Start Claude Code in terminal | Describe project or link Jira ticket | Agent reads config and plans implementation | Approve automated branch creation and commit.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Read the requirements in specs/feature.md, create a new branch, implement the feature, and update the testing notes."
limitations: Requires explicit user approval for destructive actions; context limits apply to massive monorepos without selective file inclusion.

title: VS Code Autonomous Coding with Step-by-Step Approval
summary_answer: Cline operates as an autonomous coding agent within VS Code, providing transparency and step-by-step control for precision work, file creation, and terminal command execution.
prerequisites: VS Code, Cline extension, LLM API key (e.g., OpenRouter, Anthropic).
reproducible_steps: Install Cline extension in VS Code | Provide a high-level task description | Review and approve each proposed file edit or terminal command | Agent executes approved steps sequentially.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Create a new React component for a data table, write the corresponding CSS, and add it to the main dashboard file."
limitations: Context management and multi-file operations can be constrained by the underlying model's token limits.
source_title: Cline — Open Source AI Coding Agent

title: Multi-Agent API Integration and Orchestration
summary_answer: AutoGen orchestrates multi-agent workflows where specialized agents (e.g., coder, reviewer) converse to complete complex tasks, with support for directed graph execution (GraphFlow).
prerequisites: Python, `pyautogen` package, LLM API configuration.
reproducible_steps: Define agent roles (e.g., UserProxy, Assistant) | Specify conversation topology using GraphFlow | Initiate task with a seed message | Monitor agent chat for task completion.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Agent A writes a Python script to fetch data, Agent B reviews it for security, and Agent C executes it if approved."
limitations: Managing shared state across multi-agent conversations requires careful design to avoid infinite loops or context loss.

title: Durable Multi-Agent Content Creation with State Management
summary_answer: CrewAI Flows coordinate multiple specialized agents (e.g., researcher, writer, editor) in a stateful, sequential workflow to produce and refine long-form content.
prerequisites: Python, `crewai` package, LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Define Crew roles and tasks | Chain tasks using CrewAI Flows for state management | Execute the flow | Review the final aggregated output.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Researcher gathers 5 sources on topic X, Writer drafts an 800-word article, Editor checks for SEO keywords and readability."
limitations: Requires explicit definition of agent roles and task dependencies; complex state management can increase debugging time.

title: Stateful Customer Service Chatbot with Branching Logic
summary_answer: LangGraph orchestrates complex, multi-turn conversations with memory, branching, and tool use, ideal for retail or customer service workflows requiring durable execution.
prerequisites: Python, `langgraph` package, LangChain setup.
reproducible_steps: Define graph nodes (e.g., router, tool_caller, responder) | Set up conditional edges based on LLM output | Compile the graph | Invoke with a user query and stream the response.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "If user asks for order status, route to 'check_order' node; else, route to 'general_qa' node."
limitations: Steeper learning curve due to low-level primitives; requires manual management of graph state schema.

title: No-Code AI Agent Workflow with External App Integrations
summary_answer: n8n combines AI models with 2,000+ app integrations to perform tasks, make decisions, and trigger actions (e.g., reading a Gmail attachment and updating a Google Sheet via an AI Agent node).
prerequisites: n8n instance (cloud or self-hosted), API keys for target services.
reproducible_steps: Create a new workflow in n8n | Add an AI Agent node and configure the LLM provider | Connect tool nodes (e.g., Gmail, Google Sheets) | Activate and trigger the workflow.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Read the latest email from <sender>, extract the invoice amount, and append it to the 'Invoices' Google Sheet."
limitations: System prompts can become unwieldy as workflow complexity scales; requires careful modular routing.

title: Deterministic, Self-Healing Browser Automation (RPA 2.0)
summary_answer: Browser Use enables AI agents to operate a real browser (click, type, navigate) for web tasks that lack APIs, with Workflow Use providing deterministic fallbacks if a step fails.
prerequisites: Python, `browser-use` library, local or cloud browser environment.
reproducible_steps: Install browser-use | Define a natural language task (e.g., "Log in and download the monthly report") | Execute the script | Review the agent's step-by-step browser actions.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Navigate to <URL>, click the 'Download' button, and save the file to the local directory."
limitations: Can be slow and error-prone on highly dynamic or CAPTCHA-protected websites; requires careful handling of asynchronous page loads.
source_title: Browser Use — Browser Agents and Cloud Browsers

title: Clean Markdown Web Extraction for AI Agent Context
summary_answer: Firecrawl converts entire websites into clean markdown or structured data, serving as a web extraction engine and MCP server to feed accurate context into AI agents.
prerequisites: Firecrawl API key or self-hosted instance, Python/Node.js environment.
reproducible_steps: Obtain Firecrawl API key | Call the `/crawl` or `/scrape` endpoint with a target URL | Receive clean markdown output | Pass the markdown to an LLM for synthesis.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Crawl <domain.com> up to depth 2, return only markdown, and exclude navigation/footer elements."
limitations: Rate limits apply on free tiers; complex JavaScript-rendered sites may require additional wait configurations.
source_title: Firecrawl — Web Data & Scraping Infrastructure for AI Agents

title: Local Code Execution and Interface Testing Agent
summary_answer: Open Interpreter runs locally to execute code, control web apps in a real browser, and operate system interfaces, acting as a desktop agent for tasks between applications.
prerequisites: Python, `open-interpreter` package, local environment permissions.
reproducible_steps: Install via pip | Run `interpreter` in terminal | Grant permission for code execution | Provide a task like "Analyze this CSV and plot a chart".
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Read the source document, write a Python script to extract the data, execute it, and display the result."
limitations: Runs in interactive sessions (not 24/7 autonomous by default); requires careful sandboxing to prevent destructive local commands.
source_title: Open Interpreter — Local AI Coding & Desktop Agent

title: Visual Drag-and-Drop AI Agent and LLM Workflow Builder
summary_answer: Flowise provides a visual, no-code/low-code interface to build agentic systems, connecting LLMs, APIs, and vector databases through modular drag-and-drop nodes.
prerequisites: Node.js, npm, Flowise installation.
reproducible_steps: Install and start Flowise | Open the web UI | Drag and drop nodes (e.g., Chat Model, Vector Store, Agent) | Connect nodes and test the chat interface.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Use a Conversational Retrieval QA chain with a PDF loader to answer questions based on the uploaded document."
limitations: Visual workflows can become cluttered for highly complex logic; custom tool creation requires JavaScript/TypeScript knowledge.
source_title: Flowise — Visual AI Agent & LLM Workflow Builder

title: Autonomous Documentation and PR Review Engineering
summary_answer: Devin is used by engineering teams to automate repetitive documentation tasks, generate changelogs, and perform large-scale edits or PR reviews across a codebase.
prerequisites: Devin platform access, repository permissions.
reproducible_steps: Assign a documentation or PR review task to Devin | Devin explores the repo and plans the changes | Devin writes and tests the code | Human reviews the submitted PR.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Update the API documentation in the /docs folder to reflect the new endpoints added in the last sprint."
limitations: High cost per task; best suited for well-defined, bounded tasks rather than open-ended architectural design.
source_title: Devin — The Autonomous AI Software Engineer

title: Autonomous Planning and Execution of End-to-End Workflows
summary_answer: Manus acts as a general-purpose action engine that autonomously plans, executes, and delivers complete workflows (e.g., research, coding, spreadsheet creation) from a single high-level goal.
prerequisites: Manus platform access, necessary API credentials for target tools.
reproducible_steps: Provide a high-level end goal (e.g., "Research competitors and build a comparison spreadsheet") | Manus breaks down the plan | Manus executes sub-tasks autonomously | Review the final delivered output.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Find the top 5 SaaS competitors in niche X, summarize their pricing, and create a Google Sheet with the findings."
limitations: As a general-purpose agent, it may require "Manus Skills" or custom configurations to handle highly specialized enterprise workflows reliably.

title: Sandboxed Autonomous Agent for Reasoning and Code Execution
summary_answer: Agent Zero runs autonomous agents in Docker sandboxes, allowing them to reason, use tools, manipulate files, and execute code safely without compromising the host system.
prerequisites: Docker, Python, Ollama or remote LLM API.
reproducible_steps: Clone Agent Zero repository | Start the Docker environment | Configure the LLM provider | Issue a task requiring file creation and execution.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Create a Python script to scrape this URL, save the output to a JSON file, and verify the file contents."
limitations: Steeper learning curve for users unfamiliar with Docker; performance depends heavily on the chosen local or remote model's reasoning capabilities.
source_title: Agent Zero — Open Source Agentic Framework

title: API-Driven GUI Observation and Control for Complex Workflows
summary_answer: Claude Computer Use observes the screen via screenshots and issues mouse/keyboard actions to automate complex GUI-dependent workflows that lack programmatic APIs.
prerequisites: Anthropic API key with Computer Use beta access, environment capable of rendering and sending screenshots.
reproducible_steps: Set up the Computer Use API client | Define the target application and goal | Loop: send screenshot to Claude, receive action coordinates, execute action | Monitor for task completion.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Open the desktop accounting app, navigate to the 'Reports' tab, and export the last month's data as a CSV."
limitations: Remains slow and error-prone on highly dynamic GUIs; requires structured error recovery patterns for production reliability.

title: Lightweight Code-First Orchestration for Vertical AI Agents
summary_answer: The OpenAI Agents SDK provides a lightweight, code-first framework to build agents that plan, complete tasks using tools, and hand off work in multi-agent workflows.
prerequisites: Python, `openai-agents` package, OpenAI API key.
reproducible_steps: Install the SDK | Define an Agent with specific instructions and tools | Use `Runner.run()` or `Runner.run_streamed()` to execute the agent | Handle the final output or handoff.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Agent A extracts data using a search tool, then hands off the structured data to Agent B for formatting and email dispatch."
limitations: Designed for text-based workflows; complex state persistence across long-running tasks may require external orchestration (e.g., Temporal).

title: Local, Extensible AI Agent for Automated Code Review
summary_answer: Goose runs locally as a general-purpose AI agent, configured via prompts and workflows to analyze code changes, identify bugs, and suggest improvements during the review process.
prerequisites: Local machine, Goose installation, access to a code repository.
reproducible_steps: Install Goose | Configure it with code review guidelines | Point it to a specific PR or directory | Review the generated feedback and suggested patches.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Review the changes in this PR for security vulnerabilities, adherence to our style guide, and potential performance bottlenecks."
limitations: Local execution limits access to heavy compute resources; effectiveness depends on the quality of the provided review guidelines.
source_title: Goose by Block — Open Source AI Agent

title: Multi-Agent Collaborative Software Development Simulation
summary_answer: MetaGPT assigns different roles (Product Manager, Architect, Engineer) to LLMs, simulating a collaborative software entity that transforms a one-line requirement into a full software application.
prerequisites: Python, `metagpt` package, LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Install MetaGPT | Run `metagpt "Create a 2048 game"` via CLI | Observe the sequential generation of requirements, design, and code | Review the output in the workspace directory.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Develop a Python-based web scraper that extracts job listings and saves them to a database, following standard software engineering SOPs."
limitations: Can be token-intensive due to the multi-step, multi-role generation process; less suitable for modifying existing, highly complex legacy codebases.

title: Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Financial Trading Research
summary_answer: TradingAgents orchestrates specialized LLM-powered agents (e.g., market analyst, risk reviewer, bull/bear debaters) to collaboratively research and formulate stock trading strategies.
prerequisites: Python, `tradingagents` package, financial data API access (e.g., Yahoo Finance).
reproducible_steps: Install the framework | Define the target ticker and alpha benchmark | Run the multi-agent debate and analysis workflow | Review the generated trading plan and risk assessment.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Analyze ticker AAPL, gather recent news and fundamentals, run a bull/bear debate, and output a risk-adjusted trading recommendation."
limitations: Outputs are for research and informational purposes; not a guaranteed financial advisory tool and requires careful human oversight.

title: Long-Horizon Autonomous Deep Research and Code Execution
summary_answer: DeerFlow orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to perform long-horizon, iterative research tasks, including writing and executing code to verify findings autonomously.
prerequisites: Python, access to DeerFlow repository or hosted API, LLM configuration.
reproducible_steps: Initialize a DeerFlow session | Submit a complex research query (e.g., "Compare the performance of three ML models on dataset X") | Monitor sub-agent execution and sandboxed code runs | Retrieve the final synthesized report.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Research the latest advancements in X, write a script to validate the claims using public data, and compile a summary report."
limitations: Long-running tasks may hit API timeout limits if not properly polled or streamed; sandboxed environments restrict access to certain external networks.

title: No-Code AI Virtual Agent for Email Triage and Scheduling
summary_answer: Lindy allows users to create custom, no-code AI virtual agents ("Lindies") that automate multi-step business workflows like email triage, lead enrichment, and meeting scheduling.
prerequisites: Lindy account, connected email/calendar APIs (e.g., Gmail, Google Calendar).
reproducible_steps: Create a new "Lindy" in the dashboard | Define its goal (e.g., "Schedule meetings from inbound emails") | Connect necessary tools (Gmail, Calendar) | Activate and monitor the agent's actions.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "When an email contains a meeting request, check my calendar availability, draft a reply with 3 time slots, and wait for my approval before sending."
limitations: No-code abstraction limits highly customized, complex logical branching compared to code-first frameworks like LangGraph.
source_title: Lindy — No-Code AI Employees & Workflow Agents

title: Multi-Step Task Execution with Built-in Web Browsing and Python
summary_answer: ChatGPT Agent Mode (ChatGPT Work) autonomously executes multi-step tasks by combining web browsing, Python code execution, and file processing within a single session.
prerequisites: ChatGPT Plus/Team/Enterprise subscription, enabled Agent Mode features.
reproducible_steps: Enable Agent Mode in ChatGPT settings | Provide a multi-step prompt (e.g., "Research X, write a Python script to analyze the data, and save the chart") | Approve any requested actions or tool uses | Review the final output.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Search the web for the top 5 open-source AI frameworks, write a Python script to compare their GitHub stars, and generate a summary table."
limitations: Subject to platform usage limits; cannot access local file systems or private internal networks without specific enterprise configurations.

title: Locally-Running AI Assistant Integrated with Messaging Apps
summary_answer: OpenClaw is an open-source, locally-running AI assistant that connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, or other chat apps to manage inboxes, calendars, and automated workflows via custom "skills".
prerequisites: Local machine or private server, Node.js/Python, messaging app API credentials (e.g., Telegram Bot Token).
reproducible_steps: Install OpenClaw locally | Configure a messaging app integration (e.g., Telegram) | Install or write a custom "skill" (e.g., calendar lookup) | Send a command via the chat app to trigger the workflow.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Check my calendar for next week and draft a summary of my available slots, then send it to this chat."
limitations: Requires self-hosting and maintenance of the local environment; messaging API rate limits may apply.

title: Terminal-Native Automated Test Suite Generation and Execution
summary_answer: OpenAI Codex CLI runs locally in the terminal to inspect source files, generate unit and integration tests, execute test runners, and iteratively fix failures in a sandboxed environment.
prerequisites: Node.js 22+, OpenAI API key, local Git repository.
reproducible_steps: Install `@openai/codex` globally | Export `OPENAI_API_KEY` | Run `codex` in project root | Prompt test generation and approve sandboxed test execution.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Generate pytest unit tests for src/billing.py covering edge cases, run the suite, and fix any failures."
limitations: Sandboxing behavior differs across macOS Seatbelt and Linux containers; requires active API billing.

title: MCP-Connected Codebase Migration and Shell Automation
summary_answer: Google Gemini CLI connects to local repositories and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to perform multi-file migrations, inspect logs, and run shell diagnostics from the terminal.
prerequisites: Node.js 18+, Google account or Gemini API key, optional MCP servers.
reproducible_steps: Run `npx @google/gemini-cli` | Authenticate with Google or API key | Configure `.gemini/settings.json` with MCP tools | Execute migration prompt in target repo.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Migrate all CommonJS require statements in src/ to ES modules and verify the build passes."
limitations: Free-tier rate limits apply when authenticating via personal Google login without a paid API key.

title: Multi-Provider Terminal Coding with LSP Diagnostics
summary_answer: OpenCode provides an interactive terminal user interface (TUI) with built-in Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics, allowing developers to switch LLM providers mid-session for code edits.
prerequisites: Go or prebuilt binary, API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or local Ollama.
reproducible_steps: Install OpenCode CLI | Run `opencode` inside project directory | Select model provider | Issue refactoring task and review LSP-verified diffs.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Inspect LSP type errors across the workspace and refactor the API client types to resolve all warnings."
limitations: Plugin ecosystem is smaller than IDE extensions; terminal UI requires modern terminal emulator support.
source_title: OpenCode — Open Source Terminal AI Coding Agent

title: Asynchronous Cloud VM Bug Fixing and Dependency Upgrades
summary_answer: Google Jules clones GitHub repositories into isolated cloud virtual machines, runs setup scripts, fixes bugs or upgrades dependencies asynchronously, and submits ready-to-review pull requests.
prerequisites: Google account, GitHub repository authorization.
reproducible_steps: Open `jules.google.com` | Connect GitHub repository and select branch | Describe bug fix or dependency upgrade | Review execution plan and merge generated PR.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Upgrade React from v18 to v19, update deprecated lifecycle APIs, and ensure all Jest tests pass."
limitations: Requires GitHub-hosted repositories; asynchronous cloud VM model is not designed for sub-second local autocomplete.

title: Parallel Cloud Background Agents for Multi-Branch Feature Delivery
summary_answer: Cursor Background Agents spin up isolated remote environments connected to GitHub to implement features, run test suites, and open pull requests in parallel while developers work locally.
prerequisites: Cursor Pro/Business subscription, GitHub repository integration.
reproducible_steps: Enable Background Agents in Cursor | Connect GitHub repo and configure environment snapshot | Spawn agent task from IDE or Slack | Review remote branch diff and PR.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Implement rate-limiting middleware on the /api/v1 routes and add integration tests in a new branch."
limitations: Usage incurs compute and token charges; requires reproducible environment setup scripts for remote containers.
source_title: Cursor — AI Coding Agent & Background Agents

title: Context-Aware Multi-File Synthesis and Terminal Command Execution
summary_answer: Windsurf Cascade combines deep codebase indexing with real-time awareness of user edits and terminal outputs to plan and execute multi-file changes autonomously.
prerequisites: Windsurf IDE, Windsurf account.
reproducible_steps: Open project in Windsurf | Switch Cascade to Write mode | Describe feature or bug across multiple files | Review inline diffs and terminal command execution.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Add dark mode theme support across the Tailwind config, theme provider, and navigation header."
limitations: Proprietary IDE lock-in; heavy multi-file sweeps consume prompt credits rapidly.

title: Native GitHub Actions-Powered Issue-to-PR Autonomous Agent
summary_answer: Assigned directly to a GitHub issue, Copilot Coding Agent boots a secure GitHub Actions environment, explores the codebase, commits changes to a draft PR, and iterates on review comments.
prerequisites: GitHub Copilot Pro+, Business, or Enterprise plan, GitHub Actions enabled.
reproducible_steps: Assign `@copilot` to a GitHub issue | Monitor agent session logs in the draft pull request | Leave review comments for follow-up fixes | Approve and merge PR.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "@copilot Implement pagination on the /users endpoint and add unit tests matching existing controller patterns."
limitations: Consumes GitHub Actions minutes and Copilot premium requests; restricted to repositories on GitHub.

title: Automated Enterprise Code Transformation and Language Upgrades
summary_answer: Amazon Q Developer's transformation agent analyzes legacy repositories, plans dependency and syntax upgrades (such as Java 8/11 to Java 17), builds the project, and fixes compilation errors.
prerequisites: AWS Builder ID or IAM Identity Center, VS Code/JetBrains plugin or CLI.
reproducible_steps: Open project in IDE with Amazon Q | Select `/transform` command | Choose target language version | Review transformation diff and build verification report.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "/transform Upgrade this Maven repository from Java 11 to Java 17 and update incompatible Spring Boot dependencies."
limitations: Primary transformation workflows focus on supported enterprise stacks (.NET, Java, mainframe); AWS account setup required.
source_title: Amazon Q Developer — AWS AI Coding Assistant

title: Role-Specialized VS Code Agent Modes (Architect, Code, Debug)
summary_answer: Roo Code extends VS Code with customizable agent modes (Architect, Code, Ask, Debug, Orchestrator) that delegate subtasks with tailored tool permissions and model selections.
prerequisites: VS Code, Roo Code extension, LLM API key or local Ollama.
reproducible_steps: Install Roo Code in VS Code | Select Orchestrator or Architect mode | Define custom mode rules in `.roomodes` | Execute multi-step build with mode handoffs.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Use Architect mode to design the database schema in docs/schema.md, then switch to Code mode to generate Prisma migrations."
limitations: Complex custom mode routing requires careful prompt and permission configuration to prevent redundant loops.
source_title: Roo Code — Open-Source VS Code AI Coding Agent

title: Unified VS Code Autonomous Coding with Built-In MCP Marketplace
summary_answer: Kilo Code combines multi-mode autonomous code generation, automated error recovery, and one-click Model Context Protocol (MCP) server installation directly inside VS Code.
prerequisites: VS Code, Kilo Code extension, LLM API provider.
reproducible_steps: Install Kilo Code extension | Connect MCP servers via built-in marketplace | Run task in Code or Debug mode | Verify automated test and lint fixes.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Connect the Postgres MCP server, inspect the orders table schema, and write a type-safe repository query layer."
limitations: Rapidly evolving open-source fork; heavy MCP tool schemas can increase prompt token overhead.
source_title: Kilo Code — Open Source AI Coding Agent

title: Headless CLI Coding Agent for Automated CI/CD PR Checks
summary_answer: Continue runs both in IDEs and as a headless CLI agent (`cn`) inside CI pipelines to enforce custom engineering rules, audit pull requests, and propose inline fixes.
prerequisites: Node.js, Continue CLI (`@continuedev/cli`), LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Install Continue CLI | Define rules in `.continue/rules/` | Run `cn -p` in GitHub Actions on pull requests | Post automated review comments.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "cn -p 'Check this diff for missing database indexes or unvalidated user inputs and output a markdown checklist.'"
limitations: Requires thoughtful rule scoping in CI to avoid noisy comments on large refactoring PRs.

title: Accessibility-Tree Browser Automation and E2E Test Generation
summary_answer: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server exposes structured browser accessibility snapshots to AI agents, enabling deterministic web navigation, form testing, and Playwright test script generation without vision models.
prerequisites: Node.js, `@playwright/mcp`, MCP-compatible agent client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code).
reproducible_steps: Add `@playwright/mcp` to MCP client config | Instruct agent to navigate target web app | Agent interacts via accessibility tree refs | Save recorded flow as `.spec.ts` test.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Open https://example.com/login, test invalid password error states, and generate a Playwright TypeScript test file."
limitations: Canvas-heavy WebGL apps without semantic DOM/accessibility nodes require fallback coordinate actions.

title: Hybrid Code-and-AI Web Automation with Self-Healing Selectors
summary_answer: Stagehand by Browserbase extends Playwright with atomic AI primitives (`act`, `extract`, `observe`) so developers can mix deterministic code with self-healing natural language browser actions.
prerequisites: Node.js/Python, `@browserbasehq/stagehand`, LLM API key, optional Browserbase account.
reproducible_steps: Initialize Stagehand project | Write hybrid script combining `page.goto()` with `stagehand.act()` | Use `stagehand.extract()` with Zod schemas | Run locally or on Browserbase.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "await stagehand.act('Click the Export CSV button'); const rows = await stagehand.extract('Extract table rows', schema);"
limitations: LLM inference on every `act` step adds latency compared to pure cached Playwright selectors.
source_title: Stagehand by Browserbase — AI Browser Automation SDK

title: Vision-LLM Browser Automation for Unseen Web Portals
summary_answer: Skyvern uses vision LLMs and DOM parsing to automate complex multi-step browser workflows—such as invoice downloads, government filings, and procurement forms—across unfamiliar websites without brittle XPaths.
prerequisites: Python, Docker or Skyvern Cloud account, LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Deploy Skyvern via Docker or sign in to Skyvern Cloud | Create workflow with target URL and navigation goal | Configure TOTP/credential vault | Run and inspect step screenshots.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Log into the supplier portal, navigate to Billing History, and download all PDF invoices from last month."
limitations: Vision-based multi-step execution is slower and consumes more tokens than API or DOM-only scrapers.

title: Sandboxed Virtual Desktop Infrastructure for Computer-Use Agents
summary_answer: Cua provides lightweight macOS and Linux virtual machine sandboxes paired with a Python SDK so vision-language agents can safely control full desktop applications via mouse and keyboard.
prerequisites: macOS Apple Silicon or Linux host, Python 3.10+, Cua SDK (`cua-agent`).
reproducible_steps: Install `cua-computer` and `cua-agent` | Launch sandboxed VM container | Initialize `ComputerAgent` with vision model | Run multi-app desktop GUI workflow.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Open LibreOffice Calc in the sandbox, import sales.csv, create a pivot summary, and export as PDF."
limitations: macOS virtualization requires Apple Silicon hardware; GUI loop latency depends on screenshot resolution.
source_title: Cua — Sandboxed Infrastructure for Computer-Use Agents

title: Type-Safe Python Agent Framework with Structured Validation
summary_answer: PydanticAI brings FastAPI-style dependency injection and Pydantic schema validation to Python agents, ensuring LLM tool calls and structured outputs conform strictly to Python types.
prerequisites: Python 3.9+, `pydantic-ai` package, LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Install `pydantic-ai` | Define `Agent` with `result_type` Pydantic model and `@agent.tool` functions | Inject runtime dependencies via `Deps` | Execute `agent.run()` with automatic retry validation.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Define a SupportResponse Pydantic model and validate all customer refund eligibility checks before returning JSON."
limitations: Code-first Python library without a built-in visual workflow canvas.

title: TypeScript-Native AI Agent and Durable Workflow Framework
summary_answer: Mastra provides a TypeScript framework for building agents with typed tools, RAG pipelines, suspend-and-resume workflows, and built-in evals designed for modern Next.js and Node.js stacks.
prerequisites: Node.js 20+, TypeScript, `mastra` CLI/SDK, LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Run `npx create-mastra@latest` | Define agents, tools, and workflow steps in TypeScript | Test in local Mastra Playground UI | Deploy to serverless or Node server.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Create a workflow that drafts a newsletter, suspends for human approval via webhook, and publishes upon confirmation."
limitations: Focused exclusively on the TypeScript/JavaScript ecosystem rather than Python.

title: Modular Multi-Agent Hierarchy and Tool Orchestration SDK
summary_answer: Google's open-source Agent Development Kit (ADK) enables developers to compose hierarchical agents (`SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `LoopAgent`) with built-in dev UI and Vertex AI deployment.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+, `google-adk` package, Gemini API key or Google Cloud project.
reproducible_steps: Install `google-adk` | Define root and sub-agents in `agent.py` | Launch `adk web` to inspect event traces | Deploy to Cloud Run or Vertex AI Agent Engine.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Coordinate a ParallelAgent to gather market news and SEC filings simultaneously, then pass results to a SynthesisAgent."
limitations: Optimized primarily for Gemini models and Google Cloud deployment patterns, though LiteLLM adapters exist.

title: Programmatic Harness for Building Custom Claude Code-Style Agents
summary_answer: The Claude Agent SDK (formerly Claude Code SDK) exposes Anthropic's agent loop, file editing, bash execution, sub-agents, and MCP connectors as a programmable Python/TypeScript library.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+ or Node.js, `claude-agent-sdk`, Anthropic API key.
reproducible_steps: Install `claude-agent-sdk` | Configure `ClaudeAgentOptions` with allowed tools and MCP servers | Stream messages via `query()` | Enforce custom `PreToolUse` permission hooks.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Build a compliance audit agent that reads repository configs with Read/Grep tools while blocking Write/Bash mutations."
limitations: Tied to Anthropic's Claude models and API billing.

title: Code-Action Minimalist Agent Framework by Hugging Face
summary_answer: Hugging Face's `smolagents` enables LLMs to express tool calls directly as executable Python code snippets (`CodeAgent`) inside sandboxed environments, reducing multi-step JSON tool-calling overhead.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+, `smolagents` package, Hugging Face token or OpenAI/LiteLLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Install `smolagents` | Instantiate `CodeAgent(tools=[...], model=...)` | Configure E2B or Docker sandbox | Run `agent.run()` on data or web tasks.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Write Python code using the provided search and calculator tools to compare 5-year GDP growth rates across G7 nations."
limitations: Executing model-generated Python requires strict E2B or Docker sandboxing in production.

title: Low-Overhead Multi-Agent Runtime with Memory and Knowledge
summary_answer: Agno provides a lightweight Python runtime for building fast-instantiating multimodal agents equipped with persistent session memory, hybrid vector search, and AgentOS monitoring.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+, `agno` package, LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Install `agno` | Define `Agent` with `SqliteDb` memory and toolkits | Compose `Team` for multi-agent delegation | Monitor runs via AgentOS control plane.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Create a research Team with a web search agent and a financial analyst agent sharing persistent SQLite session memory."
limitations: Rapid API evolution from Phidata to Agno requires pinning package versions in production.

title: Long-Term Stateful Agents with Self-Editing Core and Archival Memory
summary_answer: Letta implements OS-inspired virtual context management, allowing agents to actively read, append, and replace their own core memory blocks and query archival storage across infinite sessions.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+ or Docker, `letta` package, LLM API key.
reproducible_steps: Run `letta server` via Docker or pip | Create agent via Letta ADE or Python SDK | Configure core memory blocks (`human`, `persona`) | Interact across multi-day persistent sessions.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Remember user preferences in core memory blocks and archive completed project notes for semantic recall later."
limitations: Requires models with strong tool-calling reliability to manage memory updates without corrupting state.

title: Autonomous Multi-Source Web Research and Cited Report Generator
summary_answer: GPT Researcher spawns parallel planner and execution agents to scrape, filter, and synthesize dozens of web and local sources into structured, citation-backed research reports.

title: Agentic Browser Assistant for Multi-Tab Research and Web Actions
summary_answer: Perplexity Comet embeds an autonomous assistant directly inside a Chromium-based browser to summarize open tabs, compare products across pages, and execute multi-step web tasks.
prerequisites: Perplexity account, Comet browser desktop installation.
reproducible_steps: Install and sign into Comet browser | Open target research tabs | Invoke Comet assistant sidebar | Delegate cross-tab comparison or form navigation.
config_or_prompt_pattern: "Compare specs, pricing, and return policies across all 4 open laptop tabs and build a ranked comparison table."

title: Sandboxed Multi-Agent Penetration Testing and Recon Orchestrator
summary_answer: PentAGI orchestrates specialized security agents inside isolated Docker containers equipped with standard reconnaissance and exploitation tools to run authorized vulnerability assessments.
